model_system: cubic-symmetric j=3/2 Luttinger semimetal with quadrupolar Kondo coupling, applied to PrBi

key_params.normal_state_hamiltonian: H0(k)=c0 k^2 + sum_{i=1}^5 c_i d_i(k) gamma_i - mu
key_params.interaction: attractive d-wave pairing channel with g_da=-g; s-wave neglected

headline_claim: For zero quadrupolar order, the weak-coupling ground state is the time-reversal-breaking d_{x^2-y^2}+i d_{3z^2-r^2} superconductor whose Bogoliubov spectrum contains 16 pockets, with each red/blue pocket carrying Chern number +2/-2.
replication_difficulty: high - requires reconstructing the Luttinger-BdG mean-field free-energy minimization and topological invariant calculation from the paper/SI.
